releaseNotes:
v6.6.0 — Mandatory Performance & Stability Update

• Equalizer Tuning & Reset Flat: Fixed EQ flat preset and slider scaling, added instant 1-tap 'Reset Flat' button.
• In-App Privacy & Transparency: Added clear privacy policy with user acceptance in onboarding and settings.
• Active Device Telemetry: Lightweight, privacy-respecting install counter with full opt-out control.
• Notification & Playlist Fixes: Official Raazi branding in notifications and correct playlist names.
• Instant Lyrics Caching: Instantaneous lyrics loading for cached tracks.
